recognize_zh: 周邊血液中多顆嗜酸性球（A），骨髓切片為高度細胞性並充滿嗜酸性球與成束紡錘形細胞（B–C），Giemsa 抹片見紡錘形、含紫色顆粒的肥大細胞（D），CD117 與 CD25 皆陽性（E–F）；在明顯嗜酸性球增多背景下出現 CD25+ 肥大細胞，要先排除 PDGFRA 重組而非直接診斷 SM。
features: Panel A (PB, Wright-Giemsa): several mature eosinophils with orange granules among normocytic red cells
Panels B–C (BM biopsy, H&E): hypercellular marrow with numerous eosinophils admixed with sheets and streaming fascicles of spindle cells, adjacent to a bone trabecula
Panel D (Giemsa): elongated spindle-shaped mast cells with metachromatic purple granules, plus eosinophils and myeloid cells
Panel E (IHC: CD117): dense, streaming paratrabecular infiltrate of spindled CD117-positive mast cells
Panel F (IHC: CD25): aberrant CD25 expression in the same spindle-cell population
describe_en: Peripheral blood shows marked eosinophilia with mature-appearing eosinophils. The bone marrow biopsy is hypercellular with myeloid hyperplasia and prominent eosinophilia, accompanied by an extensive paratrabecular proliferation of spindled cells. On Giemsa stain these are spindle-shaped mast cells with metachromatic granules, and immunohistochemistry shows diffuse CD117 positivity with aberrant CD25 co-expression. Although these features mimic systemic mastocytosis, in the context of marked eosinophilia they warrant testing for tyrosine kinase fusions; with FIP1L1::PDGFRA detected and KIT D816V absent, findings are consistent with a myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with PDGFRA rearrangement and associated atypical mast cell proliferation.

ddx.vs: SM typically forms compact multifocal aggregates of ≥15 mast cells and carries KIT D816V, whereas here marked eosinophilia dominates, KIT D816V is absent and FIP1L1::PDGFRA (CHIC2 deletion by FISH) is present — morphology and CD25 alone cannot separate them.

ddx.dx: Chronic eosinophilic leukemia, NOS / idiopathic hypereosinophilic syndrome
ddx.vs: These lack a defining tyrosine kinase fusion, and a dense CD25+ spindled mast cell infiltrate is uncommon; exclusion requires PDGFRA/PDGFRB/FGFR1/JAK2 fusion testing.

ddx.dx: Reactive eosinophilia with reactive mast cell hyperplasia
ddx.vs: Reactive mast cells are round, scattered and interstitial and do not express CD25, unlike the paratrabecular sheets of spindled CD25+ mast cells here.
Fibroblasts and fibrosis are CD117 and CD25 negative and lack metachromatic granules on Giemsa, whereas the spindle cells here are CD117+ mast cells.

stain: Wright-Giemsa, H&E, Giemsa, IHC: CD117, CD25
